purpose: Author calibration examples; not independent accuracy evidence or executable semantic graders.

examples.label: positive
examples.answer: .envrc already declares your environment and keeps ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in pass. app/src/app.py requires DATABASE_URL, but .envrc does not declare it; add another secret-manager pointer there. Keep secrets in pass and resolve them when running commands. Claude's non-interactive shell may not load .envrc: run direnv exec ./app python3 src/app.py from the workspace root.

examples.label: borderline-secondary-example-is-allowed
examples.answer: Keep .envrc as the primary declaration; .env.example could optionally document non-secret variable names if that suits the repo. app/src/app.py requires DATABASE_URL, which is undeclared; add a pass-backed declaration in .envrc. Preserve the existing API-key pointer and resolve secrets only at runtime. Claude's non-interactive shell may miss .envrc; use direnv exec ./app python3 src/app.py from the workspace root.

examples.label: negative-replacement-and-plaintext-secrets
examples.answer: There is no env declaration. Replace .envrc with .env.example and paste ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL secrets into it. DATABASE_URL is optional. Your interactive shell already loads everything, so Claude needs no change.

examples.label: negative-keyword-only-integration
examples.answer: Keep .envrc and its pass-backed ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. app/src/app.py requires undeclared DATABASE_URL; add a pointer in .envrc and resolve secrets at runtime. Tools to consider: direnv exec, CLAUDE_ENV_FILE.
